description: def run(&b) -- the block parameter as a *declared* parameter rather than an out-of-band one. Tier 9b already types `&b` (`callDefBlk` puts the block in `paramEnvB`); what this rung adds is that `Param.block` is a parameter kind the `def'` rule must accept rather than refuse, which `Frontier` item 11 records it refusing. `version/parser.rb`'s `initialize(regex, &block)` is the slice's use.
